subject: Genetics
title: Blue Eyes Origin
description: A fast breakdown of Blue Eyes Origin for builders.

hook.text: Every blue-eyed person on Earth traces back to one ancestor near the Black Sea about 10,000 years ago.

buildup.text: A mutation in the OCA2 gene reduced melanin production in the iris. Brown eyes became blue. One person, one change.

discovery.text: Blue eyes don't have blue pigment. Less melanin lets light scatter, creating blue—like the sky. It's structural color.

twist.text: The mutation spread rapidly. Some scientists think sexual selection drove it—blue eyes were novel and attractive.

climax.text: Today 300 million people have blue eyes. All from a single mutation in a single person thousands of years ago.

punchline.text: One ancestor. One mutation. 300 million blue eyes.

quiz.question: Why do blue eyes appear blue?
options: Light scattering due to less melanin
